Specification: This module defines a bounded model-checking wrapper around a single-node read system specified elsewhere. It adds history-bound guards to the read-only transaction request and response actions, and combines them with an existing single-node next-state action from another extended module. The temporal property defined here is a simple safety-style specification stating that the system starts in Init and then evolves according to the stuttering closure of MCNextSingleNodeReadsAction over vars.
